_comment: FSPEN (Yang et al., ICASSP 2024) re-implemented into this framework; architecture hyperparameters pinned to the reference config (gitwukeyi/FSPEN): n_fft 512 / hop 256 @ 16 kHz, 5-group sub-band split of the 257 bins, 3 dual-path-extension blocks (intra 16 bidir + inter 16 in 8 groups) -> ~35k-param generator. The upstream repo ships no training recipe, so training follows the house CMGAN recipe shared with lisennet.json: VoiceBank-DEMAND, 2 s segments, AdamW lr 5e-4 betas [0.8,0.99], ExponentialLR gamma 0.98/epoch, losses (complex 0.1, mag 0.9, adv 0.05) on power-0.3-compressed spectra. compress_factor only shapes the loss domain; the network itself consumes the raw complex spectrum.
